brief: Holds a constituency parse tree of a sentence: nested phrases (S, NP, VP, PP) over words tagged with their part of speech.
detail: Where the chunker of stzText gives flat phrases, this gives the nested structure. It is reached from a text, never built by hand in practice: ParseTreeQ() on a stzText returns the root, and ParseTreeWithQ takes your own phrase grammar. The tree answers its yield (Leaves, Text), its shape (Height, Children), the phrases of a kind (NounPhrases, VerbPhrases, PrepositionalPhrases, Phrases) and two renderings (ToBracket, ToTreeString). The tags come from the stzText tagger, so a Hebrew or Arabic sentence is tagged as plain nouns.
receiver: o1 = Q("The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog").TextQ().ParseTreeQ()
example: #--> The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
